title: Study and tool orientation
introduction: Practice a repeatable study cycle, decode technical notation, check calculator settings, and verify a saved file. Build a portfolio of original practical tasks with assistance labeled separately. Completion is self-checked; independent human review is pending.

modules.title: Study deliberately and check your tools

lessons.title: Retrieve, check, and plan the next session
lessons.objective: Perform a brief closed-reference retrieval attempt, compare it with a source, record a specific correction, and plan a feasible spaced return with a concrete task and fallback.

lessons.title: Read technical text and decode notation
lessons.objective: Extract a technical passage's claim and conditions, define its symbols and units, translate its notation into a small checked example, and record a precise unresolved question.

lessons.title: Check calculator settings and expression entry
lessons.objective: Predict a benchmark result, match degree or radian mode to the input, enter grouping and scientific notation explicitly, and explain discrepancies before trusting displayed digits.

lessons.title: Organize files and verify a recoverable copy
lessons.objective: Choose a descriptive file and revision scheme, save and reopen a harmless practice artifact, compare its contents with an expected marker, and explain how app progress exports and restores affect saved work.
